title: the Sumerian mythos

banner.title: the Sumerian mythos - the D&DG walk round eighteen, print pp. 125-127: seven stat-block rows - the five greater gods (Enlil, Enki, Inanna, Ki, Utu) and the two lesser (Nanna-Sin, Nin-hursag) - plus the city-temple doctrine of the intro (the patron deity, the priest-king, the punishment ladder, the holy days) and the pantheon-wide cloud chariots doctrine of print p. 127. Every one of the seven beings prints armor class -2, the only uniform-AC pantheon of the walk.

audit_comment: THE SUMERIAN MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round eighteen, print pp. 125-127: seven stat-block rows - the five greater gods (Enlil, Enki, Inanna, Ki, Utu) and the two lesser (Nanna-Sin, Nin-hursag) - plus the city-temple doctrine of the intro and the pantheon-wide cloud chariots doctrine of print p. 127; every one of the seven beings prints armor class -2, the only uniform-AC pantheon of the walk.

tables.name: the combat grid
col_comments: The armor class cells (ALL SEVEN BEINGS PRINT MINUS 2 - the only uniform-AC pantheon of the walk; Inanna the bare-dash-minus _2 print, the w32 dash glyph matching the minus 2 tokens elsewhere)
The alternative armor class cells (none printed - all 0)
The hit point cells (Enlil 400 the high, Nanna-Sin 339 the low)
The move cells (Enlil the 127/36" print garble adjudicated 12 by the L&L voice; Utu the Infinite print minus 1 sentinel - the R863 Death and R861 Amaterasu precedent)

The alternative move cells (Ki prints the triple slash 15/36//36 - both voices carry the duplicated third 36, pinned as printed the R861 Susanowo convention with the duplicate in this comment; six dual moves, Utu the lone 0)
The attacks-per-round numerators (Inanna 2; Ki the printed 0 attacks; Enki, Nin-hursag and Utu the 3 of three-halves - Utu the 32 tesseract garble adjudicated 3/2 by the L&L voice)
The attacks-per-round denominators (Enki, Nin-hursag and Utu the 2 of three-halves; 0 = a bare number print)
The magic resistance cells (Ki and Utu 90 the highs, Inanna 66, Nanna-Sin 75, Enlil, Enki and Nin-hursag 50)

The size cells in inches (Enlil the 6 1/2 foot 78 - the (64") tesseract garble, the L&L voice reading 6.5, the R859 fraction fingerprint; Enki, Inanna, Nanna-Sin, Nin-hursag and Utu the 6 foot 72, Inanna and Utu the (&) tesseract garble with the L&L voice reading 6; Ki the 5 foot 60 - the (5) print garble)

tables.name: the class grid
col_comments: The cleric levels (Ki the 30th level high; Enlil and Enki 20; Inanna and Nanna-Sin the in-each 10 and 13 pairs; Utu 15)
The druid levels (Ki the 30th-cleric/14th-druid print; Inanna and Nanna-Sin the in-each pairs; Utu 14; Nin-hursag the 13th level druid)
The fighter levels (Nanna-Sin 16, Nin-hursag 11)
The ranger levels (Enlil 19, Inanna 20, Utu 13)
The paladin levels (Enki 13, Ki 10)
The magic-user levels (Nin-hursag the 30th level high; Enki, Inanna, Ki, Nanna-Sin and Utu the in-each pairs; Enlil 15)
The illusionist levels (the in-each rows Enki 13, Inanna 12, Ki 20, Nanna-Sin 15, Utu 15; Utu the L&L voice reads 15th illusionist alone, the print pins the in-each pair)
The thief levels (Inanna the 15th level thief)
The assassin levels (none printed - all 0)
The monk levels (none printed - all 0)

The bard levels (Ki 20 the high, Enlil 12, Nanna-Sin 15, Inanna 10, Utu 5; ENKI PRINTS THE 10TH LEVEL BARD - the L&L voice reads 13th in each, pinned by the print with the divergence noted; Nin-hursag the Nil print)

tables.name: the ability grid
col_comments: The strength cells (Enlil and Nanna-Sin 25; Ki the bare 25 with no bonus pair; Utu 24)
The strength to-hit bonuses (Ki the bare-25 print 0; the Enlil (47,4+14) tesseract garble adjudicated (+7,+14) by the L&L voice and the bracket arithmetic)
The strength damage bonuses (every god bonus pair matches the strength bracket; Utu the (+6, +12) printed-space cell)
The intelligence cells (Enki 25 the high, Enlil 25, Inanna 21, Nanna-Sin 24, Nin-hursag 23, Utu 20; Ki 23)
The wisdom cells (Enlil 25, Nanna-Sin 25, Ki 25; Inanna 19 the low)
The dexterity cells (Inanna 25 the high; ENLIL PRINTS D:23 - the L&L voice normalizes to 25, pinned by the print with the divergence noted)
The constitution cells (the 25s: Enlil, Enki, Inanna, Ki; Utu 24; Nanna-Sin 23)
The charisma cells (Inanna 25, Nanna-Sin 25, Utu 25; ENLIL PRINTS CH:24 - the L&L voice normalizes to 25, pinned by the print; Nin-hursag the all-23 row)

tables.name: the roster grid
col_comments: The print page cells (125 through 127, the Sumerian box of the gap report)
The plane cells (1 Elysium, 2 Nirvana, 3 Nine Hells, 4 Prime Material Plane)
The alternative plane cells (none printed - all 0; the L&L Phlegethos and Eronia glosses are transcriber D64 additions)
The alignment cells (0 LG 1 LN 2 CG 3 CN 4 N 5 NG 6 LE 7 NE 8 CE)
The rank cells (1 greater, 0 lesser)
The psionic class cells (I: Inanna and Ki; VI: Utu; 0 = Nil. INANNA PRINTS THE SINGLE PIPE - the w15 one-pipe signature, the L&L voice reads II, pinned by the print with the divergence noted)
The printed-damage flags (Enlil, Enki, Inanna, Nanna-Sin and Utu the fixed-points rows; Ki the Nil and Nin-hursag the 2-20 dice print carry 0)
The in-each flags (the five rows printing an Nth-level-in-each pair: Enki, Inanna, Ki, Nanna-Sin, Utu)
The odd worshipper-alignment prints (Inanna the warriors-and-lovers line - the L&L voice reads Lawful evil, pinned by the print)

bools.name: smrCityPatronDeity
bools.comment: every city has its patron deity and all the people belong to that temple and none other

bools.name: smrKingHighPriest
bools.comment: all officials of the city are clerics of the temple and the high priest is always the king or queen of the city-state

bools.name: smrSteppedPyramidTemples
bools.comment: the temples have a stepped pyramid shape in the manner of the Aztec temples

bools.name: smrZigguratRedBrick
bools.comment: the more important temples are raised up on artificial hills (ziggurats) of red brick

bools.name: smrSacrificeItemsAltars
bools.comment: sacrifices and gifts are all made as items that dress up altars and temple surroundings

bools.name: smrClericItemBurning
bools.comment: the clerics themselves make items to be directly sacrificed to the gods by burning

bools.name: smrHumanSacrifice
bools.comment: human lives are sacrificed to the gods

bools.name: smrCondemnedCriminals
bools.comment: the human sacrifices are primarily condemned criminals

bools.name: smrInnerShrineImage
bools.comment: each temple has an image of its god on a raised platform in an inner shrine closed off to the public

bools.name: smrAltarTableGifts
bools.comment: before the image is a table used as an altar with all the gifts of the year upon it

bools.name: smrCentralCourtyard
bools.comment: a central courtyard beyond the main entrance serves public worship

bools.name: smrSideChapels
bools.comment: the building has side chapels and storerooms of several types

bools.name: smrRightAngleEntrance
bools.comment: the main entrance is set at right angles to the inner temple

bools.name: smrFoodBurntNightly
bools.comment: clerics serve the best meat and drink to the gods on special tables beside altars, and the food is burnt every night for the gods use

bools.name: smrNewMoonSacrifice
bools.comment: a sacrifice is always held on the night of the new moon

bools.name: smrPunishmentGastro
bools.comment: the first major transgression results in an acute severe gastro-intestinal disease (as per DMG) for the offending cleric

bools.name: smrPunishmentTroubles
bools.comment: the second transgression results in a punishment of fifteen troubles, each worse than the last

bools.name: smrPunishmentDeath
bools.comment: the third transgression results in the death of the offending one

bools.name: smrSacrificeErases
bools.comment: any transgression can be erased in the sight of the deity by a sacrifice sufficient and important-or-expensive in proportion to the offense

bools.name: smrShavenClerics
bools.comment: clerics of this pantheon must shave all hair from their bodies

bools.name: smrWhiteKiltRobes
bools.comment: the clerics wear kilts and robes of white with colorful borders

bools.name: smrBorderIndicatesPatron
bools.comment: the shape and color of the border indicates the cleric patron deity

bools.name: smrConicalHats
bools.comment: female clerics wear rounded conical hats to cover their baldness

bools.name: smrGodsCloseToWorshipers
bools.comment: the gods are unusually close to their worshipers and every worshiper is a servant of his or her god, a willingness to help soon lost to all other mythoi

bools.name: smrBabylonianOverlap
bools.comment: the geographical area of the Sumerian mythos is almost exactly the Babylonian; the two were kept separate for diversity, deliberately increased in some cases to prevent overlap (the Greek-Roman manner)

bools.name: smrCloudChariotsAll
bools.comment: all of the gods and goddesses have cloud chariots at their personal command

bools.name: smrCloudChariotRadiance
bools.comment: the chariots appear to be clouds that give off a dazzling radiance and become platforms of transportation when a god steps on them

bools.name: smrCloudChariotImpress
bools.comment: the chariots are also a means to impress worshipers and non-believers alike

bools.name: smrCloudChariotTeleport
bools.comment: a cloud chariot can teleport itself to any place where there are clouds in the sky

bools.name: smrCloudChariotIndestructible
bools.comment: a cloud chariot is unaffected by any material force and is never destroyed

bools.name: smrCloudChariotCarry
bools.comment: the devices are capable of carrying anything the controlling deity wishes

bools.name: smrGodsAppearOnChariots
bools.comment: the gods will always appear to their clerics on such devices to prove that they are gods

bools.name: smrEnlilShapeChange
bools.comment: at will the god can shape change

bools.name: smrEnlilEspAnyDistance
bools.comment: Enlil can ESP at any distance

bools.name: smrEnlilRaiseDead
bools.comment: unlike the other deities of this pantheon, Enlil has the power to raise the dead

bools.name: smrEnlilLightningImmune
bools.comment: Enlil takes no damage from lightning or electrical attacks

bools.name: smrEnlilWarHelmUnaffected

bools.name: smrEnkiShapeChange

bools.name: smrEnkiBlinkDogMove
